title: Proper fibrewise generator gives universal local pullback triviality
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], $L$ an invertible module on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module], $k:W\to S$ any morphism and $w\in W$. Let $X_W=X\times_S W$ with projection $p:X_W\to W$ and $L_W=\mathrm{pr}_X^*L$ [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-module-pullback]. Suppose $\sigma\in\Gamma(X_W,L_W)$ is nonvanishing at every point above $w$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There is an open $V\subset W$ containing $w$ such that for every scheme $T$ and $h:T\to W$ with image in $V$, there is a finite locally free module $N$ on $T$ for which $\mathrm{pr}_X^*L\cong\mathrm{pr}_T^*N$ on $X\times_S T$, using the map $h\circ k:T\to S$. In fact the proof takes $N=\mathcal O_T$.

proof.text: Compare tensor pullback with usual pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints, using the tensor-pullback adjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction. Transport IsInvertible.pullback across the comparison to make M invertible. The nonvanishing section theorem gives its open nonvanishing locus D. Since p is proper, V = W minus p(X_W minus D) is open. The marked-fibre hypothesis says w lies in V.

For any h with image in V construct q:X_T -> X_W by pullback.lift, with second projection pr_T followed by h. A point outside D would map to the removed closed image, contradicting the image assumption. Thus q has image in D and q inverse(D)=top.

Use the unique division conclusion of nonvanishing_section_trivializes to prove sigma restricted to D is a free generator: existence gives surjectivity and uniqueness gives injectivity of multiplication on every subopen. IsFreeGenerator.pullback_unit_app carries this generator to q inverse(D). Restrict it to top using the equality of these opens. Its homOfGlobalSection is an isomorphism. Compare tensor pullback with usual pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints again, and compose this isomorphism with tensor pullback composition and the equality q followed by pr_X = pr_X. The structure-sheaf pullback isomorphism identifies pr_T^*O_T with O_X_T. Take N=O_T and compose the three isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem proper_fibre_generator_pullback_locus {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] {W : Scheme.{v}} (k : W ⟶ S) (w : W) (σ : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L, ⊤)) (hσ : ∀ x : (pullback f k : Scheme.{v}), (pullback.snd f k) x = w → x ∈ Modules.nonvanishingLocus ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L) σ) : ∃ V : W.Opens, w ∈ V ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (h : T ⟶ W), Set.range h ⊆ V → ∃ (N : T.Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree), Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ k))).obj L ≅ (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (h ≫ k))).obj N)
